rule: Two border columns (x=0, x=19) frame the grid. The interior holds one decorated motif line and one or more marker rows. A marker row has the same colour at x=1 and x=18 and is empty between them. The output clears the interior, keeps the borders, and on each marker row stamps a full line in the marker colour. That line carries the colour's fixed decoration from a lookup table: 6 box with gap x3, 7 bars x13/x15 at dy ±1 and ±2, 2 X shape at x6..8, 1 bars x14/x16 at dy ±1, 3 diamond with gap x4..6.
scope: Fixed-width20 colour-to-motif lookup with variable height12..30, one erased decorated input line and1..4 distinct-colour marker rows reconstructed using their own demonstrated shapes. Borders preserved. Independent episode verification requires all query marker shapes to appear in demonstration inputs or outputs.

authored_scope: Supported: width fixed at 20. Height 12..30, where heights other than 20 are a synthetic extension. Any border colour in 1..9 not used by the line or the markers. Line colour and row are random. 1..3 marker pairs by default and up to 4 on request, with distinct colours. Marker motifs are packed vertically at random with at least one empty row between them. Output motifs may overlap the erased input motif's rows. marker_colours lets the host restrict marker colours. Deliberately not supported: other widths (decoration anchoring would be ambiguous), colours without a known motif (4, 5, 8, 9 are never lines or markers), two markers of the same colour, a marker of the line colour, and task-level coverage enforcement.
authored_constraints: Every marker row lies outside the input motif footprint, so marker rows have empty interiors and are never mistaken for decoration.
Decoration cells never occupy x=1 or x=18, and every line row has a non-empty interior, so the only marker rows are the generated ones.
Output motif footprints are pairwise separated by at least one empty row, so stamps never overwrite each other.
Border colour is non-zero and differs from the line colour and every marker colour. Background is always 0.
Every motif fits within the grid height.
Output always differs from input: the line is erased and at least one marker motif is stamped.
All controls must be genuine ints. Bools and floats are rejected.
